name: Data Change Loop
description: Implement data changes with migration, security, validation, rollback, and release gates.
approval_boundaries: Escalate destructive data operations and irreversible migrations.
Require an explicit deployment and rollback decision for production data changes.

phases.name: Data change implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the smallest schema, migration, query, or data workflow change.

phases.name: Source and contract check
phases.instructions: Confirm behavior and data contracts against authoritative sources.

phases.name: Migration review
phases.instructions: Review ordering, locking, indexes, backfills, and rollback.

phases.name: Data security review
phases.instructions: Review sensitive data access, exposure, and authorization.

phases.name: Independent validation
phases.instructions: Run migration, data integrity, and application checks.

phases.name: Release review
phases.instructions: Review deploy order, observability, rollback, and release risk.

phases.name: Data change handoff
phases.instructions: Package changes, validation, rollback, risks, and next action.
